message.ecconia-auto-replant.no_seeds: Auto Replant: no %s in your hotbar or off-hand
message.ecconia-auto-replant.needs_tool: Auto Replant: hold an iron or better axe to harvest %s in one hit
config.ecconia-auto-replant.title: Ecconia's Auto Replanter
config.ecconia-auto-replant.enabled.tool:
Right-click a fully grown crop to harvest it and plant it again.
You can also bind a key to turn this on and off.
config.ecconia-auto-replant.delay.toolti:
How long to wait after each replant before holding right-click does the next crop.
0 = one crop every tick (fastest).
4 = vanilla speed.
After grabbing seeds from another hotbar slot, go back to the item you were holding.
Keeps a Fortune hoe (more drops) or an axe (for cocoa) in your hand.
Seeds in your off-hand are always used without switching.
config.ecconia-auto-replant.only_with_se:
Leave the crop alone if you have nothing to replant it with.
Off = harvest anyway (the first carrot or potato may stay unplanted).
config.ecconia-auto-replant.show_message: Short hints above the hotbar, for example when you run out of seeds.
config.ecconia-auto-replant.keybind_hint: Tip: set a toggle key in Options > Controls > Key Binds > Ecconia's Auto Replanter.
config.ecconia-auto-replant.crop.cocoa.t:
Replants with Cocoa Beans on the same jungle log side.
Needs an iron or better axe in hand to break in one hit.
config.ecconia-auto-replant.crop.torchfl: Fully grown torchflowers on farmland only. Replants with Torchflower Seeds.
config.ecconia-auto-replant.crop.pitcher: Fully grown pitcher plants (click either half). Replants with a Pitcher Pod.
config.ecconia-auto-replant.crop.other.t: Any other crop that works like wheat, for example crops added by other mods.
